reference.title: Glossary entry example
reference.shortdesc: <glossary id="g_glossary_api"> API Glossary Key terms used in the API documentation.

section.codeblock: <glossary id="g_glossary_api"> <title>API Glossary</title> <shortdesc>Key terms used in the API documentation.</shortdesc> <glossgroup> <title>Authentication Terms</title> <glossentry> <glossterm>API key</glossterm> <glossdef>Unique token used to authenticate and authorize API requests. Each user or application is assigned a distinct API key.</glossdef> </glossentry> <glossentry> <glossterm>OAuth 2.0</glossterm> <glossdef>Industry‑standard protocol for authorization that allows applications to access resources on behalf of a user without exposing credentials.</glossdef> </glossentry> </glossgroup> <glossgroup> <title>Data Terms</title> <glossentry> <glossterm>payload</glossterm> <glossdef>Data sent in the body of an API request or response, typically formatted as JSON or XML.</glossdef> </glossentry> <glossentry> <glossterm>endpoint</glossterm> <glossdef>Specific URL where an API service is accessed, representing a particular resource or operation.</glossdef> </glossentry> </glossgroup> </glossary>
